proposal_title: Formal Addition of GenerationJob.attempt_index and 90-Minute Safety Lease TTL
domain_specific_rationale: From a Contracts and Concurrency Control perspective, CP-018 establishes two indispensable contract primitives in domain-entities.schema.json#//GenerationJob: attempt_index (integer >= 1) and lease management fields (lease_token UUID and lease_expires_at date-time). Explicitly specifying attempt_index in the canonical contract guarantees monotonic attempt tracking and deterministic idempotency key derivation. Standardizing lease expiration semantics (90-minute safety lease TTL with 30-second worker heartbeats) provides an explicit, testable contract boundary for lease-breaking, timeout detection, and state reconciliation worker operations.
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-01 (Canonical Core State Management) and CAP-12 (Autonomous Error Recovery & Lease Reconciliation).
residual_risk: Clock skew across distributed nodes could cause premature lease expiration. Mitigated by standardizing ISO-8601 UTC timestamps (date-time) and configuring NTP synchronization across worker fleets.
